source.zone: Identity persisted branch zone/version from checkSalesTemporalAuthorization, scoped and bound to exact finalize request; never browser, shift, fixture or server deployment zone.
source.instant: First server received_at of the new acceptance invocation, captured once as UTC before external calls. occurred_at remains the separately observed client instant, never authority for operating_date.
source.date: Civil Gregorian year-month-day of received_at in the configured named IANA zone using timezone rules at that instant. No offset arithmetic, UTC substring, shift opening date or local host timezone.
source.policy: sales-branch-local-day-v1; snapshot exact zone/business_date/policy with immutable intention. Retain Identity zone version and bound source evidence in restricted origin audit.

validation.order: Validate request and current human authority before accepted lookup/replay; accepted original response wins before new source/date validation. For a new intention, validate bound zone/source freshness and compute date; compare all three submitted operating_date fields. No mutation of the immutable body or key.
validation.midnight: If observed day is stale when received, explicit conflict without acceptance/effects; show new date for review. No body edits under an uncertain/accepted key. Only a definitive no-effect response permits an explicitly reviewed new intention.
validation.replay: Exact accepted response and intention across midnight, DST, timezone/policy changes and process restart. Current authority still required. Resume retains original intention/date. Unknown/404/timeout never permits substitution or recomputation.

browser: Read authorized branch zone/server checked_at as an observation and show operative context. Preview date/policy is never authoritative; backend validates at receipt. A missing zone requires explicit authorized setup once, without plan-based UI. Re-read context after change; discard late responses and drafts on authority/context loss. No business WebStorage.
